title: GOD IS ABOUT TO MAKE A STATEMENT CONCERNING YOUR LIFE
text: Lift your hands wherever you are. Lift your hands and let's give glory to the most high God. Father, we worship you. We worship you, Lord. You are the beginning and the ending, the first and the last, the one who was and is and is to come. We give you glory, Father. We give you praise. Holy Spirit, you are welcome in this place. You are welcome in this atmosphere. Take over, Lord. Take over completely. Somebody say, "I receive it." Say it like you mean it. I receive it. Now, listen to me very carefully this morning. What I'm about to minister to you is not theory. This is not motivational speaking. This is not a pep talk. What you are receiving right now is a word, a rhema word, a proceeding word from the altar of the most high God. And I want you to receive it with all your heart. Shake off every distraction wherever you are, whether you're in your room, whether you're driving, whether you're at your place of work, position yourself because the spirit of God is speaking. God is about to make a statement concerning your life. Now, when I say God is about to make a statement, I'm not talking about something casual. I need you to understand the weight of that sentence. When God makes a statement, all of creation pays attention. When God makes a statement, time itself bows. When God decides to speak over a life, to speak concerning a man, concerning a woman, the heavens open, the earth shifts, and nothing remains the same. That is what is happening over your life right now, not tomorrow, not next year, right now, in this season, in this moment, God is making a statement. Turn with me to the book of Isaiah chapter 43. And I want you to read from verse 1. The word of the Lord says, "But now, thus says the Lord who created you, O Jacob, and he who formed you, O Israel, fear not, for I have redeemed you. I have called you by your name. You are mine." Verse 2. "When you pass through the waters, I will be with you, and through the rivers, they shall [music] not overflow you. When you walk through the fire, you shall not be burned, nor shall the flame scorch you. Verse 3. For I am the Lord your God, the Holy One of Israel, your savior. Now, stay right there. I want to show you something. The very first word in verse 1, after the introduction, is a conjunction, but now. Do you see that? But now, that phrase is a divine interruption. It means everything that has been happening, everything that has been said, every narrative that has been constructed against your life, God is stepping in right now and saying, but now. That is a transitional phrase in the vocabulary of the almighty. It means, regardless of what has been regardless of what has been the trend, regardless of what the enemy has been projecting, regardless of what the doctor said, regardless of what the financials look like, regardless of what men have said about you, God is arriving on the scene with a but now. The name but now is one of the most powerful phrases in the Old Testament. [music] When you see but now, thus says the Lord, brace yourself because something is shifting. That is what is happening to you. This is your but now season. Let me show you something else. God says, I have called you by your name, not by your tribe, not by your problem, not by your failure, not by the shame that has followed you. He said, I called you by your name. There is a difference between a general announcement and a personal [music] summons. When a teacher stands before a class and says, somebody answer this question, that is a general call. But when the teacher looks into the crowd and says, specifically you come out, that is personal. [music] God is not making a general announcement this morning. He's looking at you and he's calling your name. He knows you. He formed you. He fashioned every intricate detail of your existence and he's saying, I have called you by name. You are mine. You belong to him. You are not abandoned. You are not forgotten. You are not a mistake. You are his. That is the foundation of the statement he's about to make over your life. Now, I want you to go with me to the book of Jeremiah chapter 29 verse 11. One of the most popular scriptures in all of Christendom and yet millions of people recite it without understanding the depth that lives in it. The word says, "For I know the thoughts that I think toward you," says the Lord, "thoughts of peace and not of evil to give you a future and a hope." Now, in the Hebrew the word translated thoughts, there is the word makashaba and it doesn't just mean casual thinking. It means purposeful, deliberate, architectural design. God is saying, "I have a blueprint for you. I sat down, if I may say it reverently, I sat down in eternity and I designed a life for you. I designed an end for you. >> [music] >> I designed a future for you. I thought about you. I factored in your weaknesses. I factored in the delays. I factored in the detours. I factored in every enemy that would rise. And after factoring in everything, my thoughts toward you is still peace. My plan for you is still good. Oh God. That should make you shout right there. That should make you lift your hands right there >> [music] >> because you've been through seasons where it didn't look like peace. Seasons where it didn't look like any good plan was in motion. Seasons where you looked at your age and you looked at your circumstances and you looked at what had been lost and you wondered, "God, have you forgotten about me?" And the answer comes thundering from the throne room this morning, [music] "No. I have not forgotten you. I know the thoughts I think toward you and they are thoughts of peace. The future I designed for you is still intact." Now, here is what the enemy does. The enemy does not have the power to cancel the plan of God. He doesn't have that authority. What the devil does is he tries to get you to cancel it yourself through unbelief, through discouragement, through offense, through bitterness, through giving up. Because he knows that the moment you give up, the moment you stop standing on the promise, >> [music] >> you've done what he couldn't do. You've stepped out of the stream of grace that was carrying you. This is why the scripture says in Hebrews 10:35, "Therefore, do not cast away your confidence, [music] which has great recompense of reward. For you have need of endurance, so that after you have done the will of God, you may receive the promise." Do not cast away your confidence. Your confidence is worth something this morning. Hold on to it. The statement that God is about to make over your life requires your cooperation. It requires your faith. It requires your voice in alignment with his voice. Because here is how God makes statements. He [music] makes them through his word, he makes them through prophetic declaration, and he makes them through the manifestation of miracles in the lives of his people. And all three are converging right now over you. Let me take you to the book of Numbers chapter 23:19. This is foundational. This is a cornerstone scripture. "God is not a man that he should lie, nor a son of man that he should repent. Has he said, and will he not do? Or has he spoken, and will he not make it good?" There it is. "Has he said, and will he not do it?" The rhetorical answer is he will do it. Everything God has spoken over your life through his word, through the prophetic voices he has sent your way, through the witness of the Holy Spirit in your own spirit, he will bring it to pass. Not because you deserved it, not because you've been perfect, but because he said it, and his word does not return to him void. Isaiah 55:11, "So shall my word be that goes forth from my mouth. It shall not return to me void, but it shall accomplish what I please, and it shall prosper in the thing for which I sent it. God does not issue words that fail. When God [music] speaks, it is done. The only question is, will you hold on long enough to see it manifest in your physical reality? I want to talk to somebody who has been waiting. I want to talk to somebody for whom the waiting has been long and painful. I want to talk to somebody who started this journey with fire and enthusiasm and prayer, and right now the fire has dimmed a little, not because you stopped believing, but because the process has been hard. I hear the Lord saying to you this morning, your waiting is not wasted. Your waiting has not been invisible to heaven. In fact, let me show you something in the scripture. Psalm 37:5, "Commit your way to the Lord. Trust also in him, and he shall bring it to pass." He shall bring it to pass. You don't have to bring it to pass. You don't have to manufacture it. You don't have to manipulate your way into it. You commit, and he brings it to pass. And then over in Habakkuk 2:3, the Lord says, "For the vision is yet for an appointed time, but at the end it will speak, and it will not lie. Though it tarries, wait for it, because it will surely come. It will not tarry. It will surely come." That word surely in Hebrew carries the weight of divine certainty. It is not a hopeful maybe. It is not a wishful thinking. It is a divine guarantee. Your blessing is coming. Your breakthrough is coming. [music] Your elevation is coming. The statement God is making over your life is positive. It is glorious. It is full of light, and it is on its way. Now, I want to be very deliberate about something. I want to talk about the nature of the statement [music] God makes. Because throughout scripture, when God decided to make a statement over a person's life, things changed suddenly, quickly, overwhelmingly. Look at Joseph. Joseph went through the pit, went through Potiphar's house, went through the prison, and then in one day, in one conversation, in one divine encounter, he went from the prison to the palace. That was God making a statement. That was God saying, "I've been silent long enough. I've been allowing the process long enough. Now, I'm going to speak, and when I speak, everybody is going to know that I am God." Look at Hannah. Year after year after year, the womb was shut. Year after year, she went to Shiloh. Year after year, she wept. Year after year, the enemy taunted her. And then one day, one prayer, one encounter with the high priest, one divine response from heaven, and the womb opened. Samuel was born. That was God making a statement. God saying, "Not only will I open this womb, but I will give her a child who will change the course of a nation." That is the kind of statement God makes. Look at the disciples in the upper room. 120 people confused, afraid, hiding behind closed doors. And then suddenly, suddenly, there was a sound from heaven like a mighty rushing wind. It filled the entire house. Tongues of fire sat on each of them. They all began to speak with other tongues. That was God making a statement. And the entire city of Jerusalem was shaken by that statement. 3,000 souls were [music] saved in a single day. That was God saying, "I am glorifying myself through these broken ordinary people. I am announcing to you by the spirit of God this morning, God is about to do the [music] same for you. He's about to show up suddenly. He's about to show up overwhelmingly. [music] He's about to turn around something that has been stagnant. He's about to open something that has been shut. He's about to promote something that has been suppressed. He's about to vindicate you before the very people who doubted you. He's about to silence the enemies who said it would never happen. And I pray that everybody who sees this message, everybody who is listening to this prayer this morning will share it with someone who needs a word. Share this message. Because somewhere right now, there is someone at the edge of giving up and this word is a lifeline. This prayer is going to be a turning point [music] for them. Be deliberate about sharing it because you never know whose life you're about to change by simply forwarding this word. Now, let me address something the spirit of God is pressing me to address. One of the greatest hindrances to receiving the statement that God wants to make over your life is the spirit of unworthiness. And I have to deal with it right now because I can feel it in the atmosphere. There are people listening to this message and even as I declare these things, something in them is saying but not me. Maybe for others, but not for me. Maybe for people who have lived right, but my life has been too messy. Maybe for people who have been faithful, but I have failed too many times. And I want to speak directly to that voice. That voice is a lie. That voice is not the voice of the Holy Spirit. That voice is the voice of the accuser. Revelation 12 verse 10. The accuser of our brethren who accuse them before our God day and night. That is the voice telling you you don't qualify. But Romans chapter 8 verse 1 says, "There is therefore now no condemnation to those who are in Christ [music] Jesus. No condemnation. Not reduced condemnation. Not condemnation with footnotes. No condemnation. Period." Your qualification for what God is about to do has nothing to do with your performance. It is rooted entirely in the finished work of Jesus Christ. First Corinthians 1 verses 27 through 29. But God has chosen the foolish things of the world to put to shame the wise. And God has chosen the weak things of the world to put to shame the things which are mighty, and the base things of the world, and the things which are despised, God has chosen, and the things which are not to bring to nothing the things that are, that no flesh should glory in his presence. He chose the foolish, he chose the weak, he chose the despised, he chose the things that are not. Why? So that when he shows up powerfully in your life, nobody can take the credit except him. That is the kind of testimony he wants to write over you, not a testimony of your own achievement, a testimony of his grace, of his unmerited, unstoppable, overwhelming favor. A testimony that makes people say that had to be God. I'm speaking to someone this morning whose story is about to become a testimony that fills nations. Your pain is going to produce a platform. Your delay is going to produce a depth that cannot be manufactured. The things you have walked through, the losses, the shame, the disappointments, God is going to redeem every single one of them, and the final chapter of your life is going to make the dark chapters look small. Now, let me show you something from the New Testament before we move into prayer. Go to the Gospel of John chapter 11. Lazarus is dead. He's been in the tomb 4 days. Martha comes to Jesus, and she says, "Lord, if you had been here, my brother would not have died." And Jesus says to her something that is the hinge point of the entire narrative. He says, verse 25, "I am the resurrection and the life. He who believes in me, though he may die, he shall live. And whoever lives and believes in me shall never die. Do you believe this? Do you believe this?" That is the question reverberating through the spirit this morning. Do you believe this? Not just about Lazarus, not just about a historical miracle, but about your own situation. Your career, your marriage, your child, your business, your health, your ministry. Do you believe that the resurrection and the life is standing at the tomb of that thing and he's about to call it forth? Because then Jesus does something that I need you to see. He goes to the tomb and even though he is about to raise the dead, he asked them take away the stone. He asked human hands to do something. He involved cooperation. He didn't just miracle away the process. He said take away the stone and then he cried with a loud voice, Lazarus come forth. And the dead man came out. There are two things I want you to see. First, God is going to ask you to move some stones. Stones of unforgiveness, stones of fear, stones of prayerlessness, stones of unbelief, stones of compromise. Those are things that have to be rolled away in order for the resurrection to be visible. And second, when Jesus speaks, what was dead comes back to life. The word of God has resurrection power and I'm releasing that power into every dead situation in your life right now in the name of Jesus. Now let us pray. This is the moment, this is the altar, this is where heaven meets earth. I want you to lift your hands, I want you to open your mouth and pray along with me. Don't be a spectator this morning. Engage. Your voice [music] matters. Your faith activates the power that is already available. Pray. Father, we come before you this morning not in our own righteousness, not on the basis of our performance, but we come boldly before the throne of grace as Hebrews 4:16 commands us that we may obtain mercy and find grace to help in time of need. We thank you Father because this is our time of need and we know that you are a present help in trouble. You are not a far off God. You are Emmanuel, God with us. You are here right now and we welcome your presence with everything in us. We honor you Holy Spirit. You are the spirit of truth. You are the spirit of power. You are the spirit of might. You are the spirit of wisdom and understanding and counsel and knowledge and the fear of the Lord. Fill this atmosphere. Fill every ear that is hearing this prayer. Fill every heart that is reaching out to you right now. In the name of Jesus. Saturate this moment with your glory. Now Father, I come against every spirit of discouragement that has sat upon the lives of your people. Every spirit of hopelessness, I bind you right now in the name of Jesus. You will not have the last word. You are not the final authority. The word of God is the final authority and the word says that the plans of God towards his people are plans of peace and not of evil. So, I pull down every structure of despair. I pull down every mental stronghold that has convinced the people of God that their situation is permanent. [music] By the authority of the name of Jesus, I decree the chains are broken, the shackles are loose, the prison doors are open. Come out in the name of Jesus. Father, I bring before your throne every person listening to this prayer who has received a negative report. A medical report that said there is no hope. A financial report that said the numbers don't add up. A relational situation that looks irredeemably broken. I bring every negative report into the court of heaven and I present the blood of Jesus against it and I declare you are not the report. You are what God says. You are not the diagnosis, you are the healed of the Lord. You are not the financial statement, you are the blessed of Abraham. I speak life over every dead situation right now in the name of Jesus. Father, I pray for every person in this place who has been waiting for a breakthrough in their career, in their business, in their purpose and calling. Lord, you opened doors for Joseph that no man opened. You promoted Daniel in a foreign land without connections, >> [music] >> without a support system, you promoted him because your hand was on him. Father, do the same for your people right now. Let there be divine positioning. Let there be supernatural elevation. Let there be connections that are not of human engineering, connections that are orchestrated by heaven, connections that carry kingdom purpose. I decree every door that has been shut against you by the hand of the enemy, I command it to open right now in the name of Jesus. Every opportunity that was stolen, every blessing that was delayed, I command the restoration, sevenfold restoration in the name of Jesus. I pray for marriages. Father, there are families that are under severe demonic attack right now. Families where the enemy has sown seeds of division, seeds of strife, seeds of misunderstanding. Father, by the blood of Jesus, I neutralize [music] every demonic assignment against families. I decree peace in homes. I decree restoration of love, restoration of communication, restoration of the covenant, marriages that the enemy has declared over, God has not declared over. What God has joined together, let no man and no devil put asunder. Father, send your healing into every family situation right now. In the name of Jesus, let the walls come down and let love be rebuilt. I pray for the children. Father, we cover every child under the blood of Jesus. Every young person who has been targeted by the spirit of this age, by perversion, by confusion, by addiction, by depression, Father, I command those spirits to release them right now in the name of Jesus. Let a spirit of clarity come. Let a spirit of purpose come. Let the fire of God fall on this generation of young people and call them back to the altar. They are not lost forever. The prodigal son came home. Father, bring them home. Bring them back to the faith. Bring them back to prayer. Bring them back to the word in the mighty name of Jesus. Father, I pray for financial breakthrough with [music] specificity. Lord, there are people who cannot pay their rent. There are people who cannot afford medical care for their families. There are people whose businesses are on the verge of collapse. People who have debts that have overwhelmed them. Father, you are Jehovah Jireh, the Lord who sees ahead and provides. You fed 5,000 with five loaves and two fish. You multiply the widow's oil. You made iron float on water. You brought wealth out of a fish's mouth. Father, you are the God of supernatural provision, [music] and I'm declaring that you're about to step into the financial crisis of your people and perform a miracle, not a small thing, a sign and a wonder. [music] Something that will make people know this could only be God. I decree supernatural debt cancellation in the name of Jesus. I decree unexpected income in the name of Jesus. I decree restoration of lost finances in the name of Jesus. I decree new streams of income that were not there before in the name of Jesus. I decree divine ideas, divine inventions, divine strategies coming to your mind by the spirit of the Lord that will generate wealth and create platforms for the kingdom of God. Now, Father, I want to pray for every person who has experienced deep personal loss. Those who have lost loved ones. [music] Those who have experienced grief so heavy that getting out of bed feels like climbing a mountain. Father, you are the God of all comfort. Second Corinthians 1:3, the father of mercies, the God of all comfort. Comfort them, Lord. Reach into those deep places of grief and pain, and let your presence minister healing. Let them know that their loved one did not [music] pass into nothingness. That you are the God of the living. Let resurrection hope fill every grieving heart this morning. Let them feel your arms around them. Let them know you have not left them alone. Father, I pray for those who are in the middle of a spiritual battle. Those who feel like the enemy has surrounded them on every side. I pray the prayer of 2 Kings 6. Lord, open their eyes to see that there are more on their side than on the enemy's side. The chariots of fire that surrounded Elisha surround them right now. The angel of the Lord encamps around those who fear him and delivers them. I decree divine protection over every person in this prayer. No weapon formed against you shall prosper. That is not a wish. That is a prophetic decree from the [music] word of God. Isaiah 54:17, no weapon, no weapon, no weapon formed against you shall prosper. And Father, I want to pray for encounters. Lord, I pray for divine encounters with the Holy Spirit. There are people who have known about God for years, but haven't truly encountered him. Father, break in. Break in the way you broke into Paul on the road to Damascus. Break in the way you broke into Isaiah in Isaiah chapter 6 when he saw the Lord high and lifted up. Break into lives this morning with a revelation of your glory. Because when people see you, when they truly see you, nothing is ever the same. Priorities shift, addictions fall off, fear dissolves. Purpose comes alive. Father, manifest yourself to your people this morning in a way that they cannot explain away. Make yourself real. Make yourself tangible. Make yourself undeniable. I pray for fresh fire. Lord, every person who has grown [music] cold, who has grown dry, who once burned brightly, but the mundane and the painful has extinguished the flame. Father, by your spirit, fan the flame. Acts 2, let the fire fall again. Let there be a fresh baptism of fire. Let there there a renewal of first love as you promised in Revelation 2. Come, Lord Jesus, and restore the fire. Restore the passion. Restore the hunger. Restore the prayer life. Restore the love for your word. Make them born again. Make them hungry again. Make them seek your face like they cannot function without it. Because that is the truth we cannot function without. You You are not an addition to our lives. You are our life. Colossians 3:4, Christ who is our life. Father, I pray for supernatural speed now. What has taken years to build, [music] let the spirit of God accelerate it. There is a season described in Amos 9:13 where the plowman overtakes the reaper. That means the process of planting will be so accelerated that there is no gap between sowing and harvest. There is a [music] season of supernatural speed. Father, I decree that for the lives of your people, supernatural speed. What should have taken 10 years, let it happen this year. What should have taken 5 years, let it begin happening this month. Let there be divine acceleration over every assignment, every vision, every dream that God has placed in the hearts of his people. And Father, let there be testimonies. Let there be testimonies so powerful that people have no choice but to acknowledge that you are God. Let there be testimonies that travel. Let there be testimonies that preach. Let there be testimonies from this prayer, from this moment that become landmarks in the lives of your people. Stones of remembrance. Altars of praise. Let this be a day that they mark in their journals and say something shifted for me on this day. Something changed. I came into this prayer under pressure, and I leave it knowing that the God of the universe has made a statement over my life. Father, I pray finally for those who do not [music] yet know you. Those who stumbled upon this prayer not knowing why. Those who are listening but have never surrendered their lives to the Lord Jesus Christ. Father, let the drawing power of the Holy Spirit operate powerfully right now. Let the love of God overwhelm every resistance. Let the revelation of the cross break through every hardness of heart. Let them see that Jesus is not religion. Jesus is life. Jesus is the way and the truth and the life and no man comes to the Father except through him. And if anyone is listening right now and does not have a personal relationship with Jesus, I want to lead you in a simple prayer. Say this from your heart. Lord Jesus, I come to you. I acknowledge that I am a sinner. I believe that you died for me and rose again. I surrender my life to you right now. Be my Lord. Be my savior. Come into my heart. Fill me with your spirit. I am yours. In Jesus name. Amen. And to that person, welcome. Welcome into the family of God. Welcome into the covenant. Welcome into the inheritance of the saints. You are not the same person you were 5 minutes ago. All things have passed away and all things have become new. Find a spirit-filled church. Get into the word. Find a community of believers and watch what God begins to do. Now, I want to close with a declaration and I want you to say this with conviction. Say it with faith. Say it out loud because your voice is a creative instrument. Romans 10 verse 10. With the mouth, confession is made onto salvation, onto deliverance, onto breakthrough. Open your mouth and declare this with me. I am not forgotten. I am not abandoned. I am not a mistake. I am chosen. I am called. I am covered by the blood of Jesus. I am positioned for divine favor. I am in the right season at the right time. God is making a statement over my life and that statement is good. That statement is glorious. That statement is full of his power and his grace. The enemy has no authority over my destiny. No weapon formed against me shall prosper. I am walking into my breakthrough. I am walking into my miracle. I am walking into the fullness of what God has prepared for me before the foundation of [music] the world. I will not give up. I will not back down. I will not quit because the one who began a good work in me is faithful to complete [music] it. In the name of Jesus, I receive it. I declare it. I believe it. Amen and amen. Receive this word. Let it stay with you through this day. Return to it. Meditate on it. Let the roots go deep because a tree that is deeply rooted is not moved by the winds of adversity. Go into this day knowing that you are seen, you are known, you are loved, and God is making a statement concerning your life. That statement is already written in heaven. Now it is coming to earth. Your part is to believe, to stand, to declare, and to walk in the authority that Christ has given you. God bless you. The peace of the Lord be with you. The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ and the love of God and the communion of the Holy Spirit rest upon you, abide with you, and remain with you from this day forward and forevermore. In Jesus' name. [music]
